name: WalkMyPlan — Floor Plans in 3D
original_description:
Describe the home you want — "a 10 by 10 house with a master bedroom and a private bathroom, two kids' rooms, an open kitchen and living room, a garden with trees" — and WalkMyPlan builds it in one go: real walls, doors, windows, furniture and garden. Open the live link and walk through it in 3D.

Keep designing in conversation. "Make the living room bigger." "Put a TV on the north wall." "I marked pin A — put the front door exactly there." Furniture placement is automatic — it finds a free spot, away from doorways. Every edit lands in a revision history you can undo or roll back to any point. Edits are for visualization and planning; WalkMyPlan does not check structural safety or building codes.

Ask about what you built. "How big is the kitchen?", "Is there room for a double bed in the small bedroom?" Answers are measured from the model's real geometry.

See it for real. Ask for a photorealistic image and get a link that turns your current design into a picture of the finished home, generated from the plan's exact measurements. Make a short video that moves over it, or download a printable PDF sheet at true architectural scale with dimensions — one ask each.

Build in storeys. Stack your floor plans into one building, line the floors up over each other, and connect them with stairs and lifts - the whole building opens as one 3D model you can walk floor to floor. Balcony sliding doors and glass shopfront vitrines are real objects, handles included.

Build a tower without designing it twice. Design one typical floor, make up to 19 copies, and stack as many as 20 storeys into a single walkable building - then change only the floors that differ. Ask for a plan check at any point and get measured, specific feedback on room sizes, circulation and daylight.

Share and collaborate. Share a plan privately with named people as viewers or editors, or with a link. See who changed what, when.

Already have a plan? Upload one intended floor plan per file - a PDF, an image (PNG, JPG or WebP) or a DWG, up to 100MB - or draw it on the sketch pad. A PDF or image opens as tracing paper in the Sketch pad. For DWG, WalkMyPlan reads the drawing's real scale and layers and shows it exactly in a view-only CAD Source view beside the automatic proposal, where you trace over it and confirm or reject the automatic walls.

Great for home design, interior design, room planning, renovation, and planning a build. Your plans stay private to your account unless you share them and can be deleted any time (trash keeps them recoverable for 30 days). See the privacy policy for how plan data may be used to test and improve WalkMyPlan's plan-reading technology and how to opt out.

Try: "Build me a three-bedroom house with a garden" — then "show me a photorealistic image."
